evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 7 semesters
the Matriculation / School Leaving Certificate has to be uploaded into the University’s online application system by the 1st of August the year of application

notes: Tuition fee of 2,700 EUR per semester is the Non-EEA rate for Engineering Management as listed in the university's tuition fees table (specialisation: Projectmanagement). Durée 7 semestres = 3,5 ans. The application deadline '31th May, 2026' on how-to-apply is a general university deadline; no page states this deadline is specifically for non-EU applicants, so applicationDeadline is omitted. Requirement evidence quote combines two adjacent lines. Translation evidence: 'with verified English translations' from programme page and 'certified English translation' from application-deadlines page.

note.fr: Un examen d'entrée est requis : épreuve écrite de mathématiques et entretien oral d'anglais en ligne. Préparez-vous à ces évaluations.
note.en: An entrance examination is required: written mathematics examination and online English oral interview. Prepare for these assessments.

evidence.quote: Entrance examination: Yes Entrance type: both Minimum level of language proficiency (oral): IELTS 5.0

note.fr: Vous devez avoir au moins 18 ans au début des études (fin septembre 2026). Vérifiez cette condition avant de postuler.
note.en: You must be at least 18 years old by the start of the study period (end of September 2026). Check this condition before applying.

evidence.quote: Applicants must be at least 18 years old by the start of the study period in the Fall semester of Year 1 at the University
